adopt: Validate one character spec and see exactly which field is wrong.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
A character factory returns a pile of meshes, rigs and clips, and every consumer re-invents its own idea of whether that pile is complete and loadable. The question is the same everywhere and the answer differs everywhere.

Install
pip install awavatar
synopsis: One character spec in, a rigged, animated, multi-style asset pack out.
